method.candidate: Compare an earlier video with a longer submitted video. Fit one frame insertion and preserve all earlier frames in order. Use 96-square luma standardized per frame. Require at least 24 authentic frames on each side, a median retained difference no greater than .10, and a 90th percentile no greater than .22 on each side. Withhold if the candidate split is ambiguous by over 3 frames at the fixed profile-distance tolerance.
method.confirmed_deliveries: Render a matching 480-pixel-long-side H.264 picture stream at exact 24 fps. Use the frozen generated slice and insertion split. Ordinary insertion prepends a repeated authentic part from the reference at that split. The equal-length replacement uses the same generated slice and clamps the split when needed to preserve an authentic 24-frame suffix.
method.measurement: Keep candidate settings unchanged and report exact, within three frames and outside-three results. Run the existing earlier-copy app comparison with all locally enabled picture options on the same delivered pairs. Count ordinary insertions as physical edits, regardless of generation.
method.scope: Physical insertion between two copies. Zero AI-confidence weight. Authored deliveries use new source groups from one publisher, no sound, and no learned weights.
method.source_separation: Check exact file and decoded luma commitments against the eight candidates and all eight preflight original/generated clips. Search for exact 96-square frames and close 24-square downsampled sequences. A run of at least 12 nearly identical detailed pictures at the same relative offset counts as a possible near-duplicate. Retain any rejected candidate in the denominator.
method.unchanged_and_wrong: One unchanged control per source, with independent re-encoding settings identical to the earlier delivery. For each generated delivery, use the next source in plan order as a wrong reference. Match its geometry, cadence and earlier length, looping if needed.
